_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/riverwoodhaswalls:.$EnabledMaintenance_Help: Uncheck this option if you want mod-specific variables not to be loaded. This does not apply to variables in the settings file and when the script is upgraded to a newer version. Disabling this option is useful when there are conflicts with other mods during autoload.
line:menu_translation/riverwoodhaswalls:.$LoadSettingsMaintenance_Help: Forces the modification to reload the settings. Useful if autoloading is disabled.
line:menu_translation/riverwoodhaswalls:.$LoadSettingsonReloadMaintenance_Help: Check this option if you want the settings to be loaded every time you load the game. Useful if you have something that reverts settings. This option will not work if the base mod does not use the OnGameReload event or if you disabled Autoload.
line:menu_translation/riverwoodhaswalls:.$LoadingDelayMaintenance_Help: Settings loading delay in seconds. Useful if the mod takes time to initialize.
line:menu_translation/riverwoodhaswalls:.$RiverwoodHasWallsSkipBuilding_Help: Will instantly build the fortifications. Cannot be reverted once toggled.
line:menu_translation/riverwoodhaswalls:.$RiverwoodHasWallsStage2_Help: Configure waiting time from stage 1 until stage 2
line:menu_translation/riverwoodhaswalls:.$RiverwoodHasWallsStage3_Help: Configure waiting time from stage 1 until stage 3
line:menu_translation/riverwoodhaswalls:.$RiverwoodHasWallsStage4_Help: Configure waiting time from stage 1 until stage 4
line:menu_translation/riverwoodhaswalls:.$VerboseMaintenance_Help: Check this option to see additional information during loader work.
